name: aXtn SupaCase Management
description: Lightweight persistent business-work and case-management capability with hierarchical cases, accounts, contacts and explicit relations to documents and other cases.
permissions: authenticated user; case datasets are user-owned and access remains scoped to the authenticated owner
data_contracts: Case is the persistent business work object; Swarm Runs remain technical execution records.
Logical user-owned datasets: axtn_cases, axtn_accounts, axtn_contacts and axtn_case_relations.
Cases support nullable parent_case_id with arbitrary hierarchy depth; children use the same Case contract.
Case relations are explicit and can target document, contact, account or case without duplicating the target object.
Case lifecycle fields include subject, type, status, reason, priority, due date, follow-up, account, primary contact, related entity, source kind/id and timestamps.
READY_FOR_FILING completion ensures exactly one Case plus explicit Document relation for the accepted document, idempotently.
Accounts and Contacts remain intentionally thin identity/context records rather than a parallel CRM.
known_limitations: Account and Contact management is intentionally minimal and not a full CRM.
The restored implementation continues to use generic user datasets rather than a dedicated physical SupaCase schema.
Host/runtime acceptance is required before this restored capability is treated as deployed.
